scope: Primary-source metadata and expected integrity only. No downloaded data bytes, authorized ingestion, split qualification or clinical evidence. Do not automatically promote any record to approved.

limitations: one PSV per subject; rows represent hours, NaN denotes unrecorded measurement
SepsisLabel is shifted six hours relative to defined onset; not an observed diagnosis timestamp
Unit1/Unit2 are ICU type not verified hospital site; treat A/B as cohort partitions unless independently confirmed
mask observed values only; do not assume latent disease states or intervention outcomes; no future measurements in input

underlying vignette and source component rights require resolution
exclude model outputs and gold labels from input; independently assess patient/trial overlap, exact label vocabulary, provenance and anchoring bias
published standard version and observed source head not assumed equivalent
verify rights per copied example or test; do not redistribute protected standard text or third-party clinical content
observed source head is beta, not qualified runtime selection
fixtures reflect CQL 1.4.0 or other declared library versions; validate exact compatibility
verify per-fixture rights, exact bytes and translator/runtime conformance; don't equate implementation output with independent ground truth
